entradas.text: "How is everything going, Mr. Clavin?"
entradas.menu: "How is everything going, Mr. Clavin?"

entradas.text: After our meeting with Gloria Tory, and further discussions with the party and my cabinet, it was time to talk to Albin Clavin to get the reformist wing to support the proposal.
"Mr. President! Welcome!"
I also planned to finally present a more fleshed out proposal and declare our agenda to the party after our meeting.
I walked into the left wing of the Assembly and entered the quarters of the USP. When I reached the meeting hall, I saw many of our members conversing inside.
After taking a glimpse inside, I went back into the corridor to look for the office of Albin Clavin, which was around the back of the place.
When I reached his room, I knocked on his door and entered.
The whole room was surrounded by bookshelves packed with files and papers. It was a small office, with books and dossiers lying on every corner. It felt claustrophobic.
On his gesture, I took a seat.
"Did a bomb drop in this office?"
entradas.menu: "Did a bomb drop in this office?"

entradas.text: He laughed.
"It's been busy. The party has been working very hard, Mr. President. Thank you for asking."
"How is it going for you in the Palace?"
"You could say that."
"So much research and preparation needs to be done on the plans we're working on."
"How is everything going for you, Mr. President?"
"It's pretty tough."
entradas.menu: "It's pretty tough."

entradas.text: "I'm feeling pretty good."
entradas.menu: "I'm feeling pretty good."

entradas.text: "It depends on our meeting today."
entradas.menu: "It depends on our meeting today."

entradas.text: "Oh, I see. Then I'll try my best not to make it any worse for you, Mr. President."
"I can't imagine the work you're dealing with up there."
"That's great to hear."
"Anyway, sir, let's talk about the proposal. Thanks for coming here for my input because there are some subjects where Gloria and I don't see eye to eye."

"I have to say that most of the progressives were already starting to warm up to you. Your attempt at changing the constitution created quite a bit of excitement. One could dare to say an excitement that hasn't been felt since the 30's..."
"Yet, there are some issues with the current status of the draft proposal. So we may need to contain our excitement a little longer."
"I've read the proposal that was finalised together with Mrs. Tory. And surprisingly, it came out pretty good."
"I have to say that the proposal is unacceptable in its current state."
The meeting had exhausted me.
I went to the restaurant of the Assembly to get something to eat while conversing with other members of our party.
I saw Albin talking to his people in the distance.
After a while, the preparations for the conference began and I went back into the conference hall and prepared my notes for the speech I was going to make.
It took time to get all of the present members of the party inside the hall. Gloria Tory announced me from the stand.
I walked up to the stand as everybody in the room started clapping.
"Dear members of Assembly, I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entradas.menu: "Dear members of Assembly..."

entradas.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Party! I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Party!"

entradas.text: "Brothers and sisters of United Sordland! I came here today to announce the agenda for the future of our country."
entradas.menu: "Brothers and sisters of United Sordland!"

entradas.text: I started my speech with the reasons of the changes to the Constitution.

"The people of Sordland have spoken! They blame our institutions and our systems, and want change! Can you blame the people? Haven't we had enough with the flaws of our Constitution? We must listen their wishes, and get their trust in Sordland back!"
entradas.menu: "The people of Sordland have spoken..."

entradas.text: "Our system and institutions have increasingly became undemocratic over the decades after Soll tightened his grip on the country. Since then, we have a Supreme Court that obstructs the duties of the President and the Assembly. We must finally be brave enough to go against the status quo that they created and write a new Constitution!"
entradas.menu: "Our system and institutions have increasingly became undemocratic..."

entradas.text: "The Supreme Court is blocking the future of Sordland yet again, since President Soll has placed these Judges there. They believe that they are the sole protectors of the Constitution and real leaders of Sordland even though they weren't even elected. We must be brave enough to break their power over us and bring the change Sordland has been so eagerly waiting for!"
entradas.menu: "The Supreme Court is blocking the future of Sordland..."

entradas.text: I paused as they started clapping and continued.
I paused when some people started clapping but it was short lived. After taking a breath, I continued.
I brought attention to democracy and why we must write a more democratic Constitution. I explained how our proposal will fix the issues.
entradas.menu: Talk about democracy.

entradas.text: I brought attention to the people's protests and the slight decrease in the popularity of USP. I explained how our proposal will only be beneficial for everybody.
entradas.menu: Talk about why USP needs this to survive the next elections.

entradas.text: I blamed the Old Guards for not allowing the legislative to do their work. I explained how more reforms can be done if their power over constitutional changes were to be limited.
entradas.menu: Target the Old Guards and the Supreme Court.

entradas.text: A round of applause from the left was heard.
The left side of the hall where Albin sat started applauding.
The moderates that sat in the centre started applauding.
Later I explained the contents of the new Constitution and asked for their full support for the proposal.
I announced that any opposition to the proposal will not be tolerated and will be declared as traitors to the party.
entradas.menu: Threaten them to vote yes.

entradas.text: I asked for each and every member's vote to make a change together.
entradas.menu: Ask for their votes.

entradas.text: I told them what they must do and what was expected of them.
entradas.menu: Order them to vote yes.

entradas.text: The reformist wing on the left stood up and started clapping loudly after Albin Clavin made a sign.
Soon after, most of the party members stood up and joined in.
The conservatives on the right side of the hall where Gloria sat stood up and started clapping loudly after I saw Gloria making a gesture with her hands.
There wasn't much reaction from the party.
I saluted everybody in the room one last time and bid them farewell before leaving the stand.
I walked outside the Assembly and back into the Palace...
"I've already read the proposal you've made. It looks pretty good. No surprise that Mrs. Tory didn't give her support."
"I suspect that Mrs. Tory had a lot of influence on this proposal. I have to say that the proposal is unacceptable in its current state."
"...which unfortunately has been crushed with the current draft."
"This is in no way what we intended nor asked for."
"I cannot support this in its current state."
"I suspect that Mrs. Tory had a lot of influence on this proposal. But I cannot support this in its current state."
"The party should respect my decisions."
entradas.menu: "The party should respect my decisions."

entradas.text: "I need your support, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "I need your support, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "I thought you were a democrat."
entradas.menu: "I thought you were a democrat."

entradas.text: "What's the problem?"
entradas.menu: "What's the problem?"

entradas.text: "That would have been very nice for you, wouldn't it, Mr. President?"
"With all due respect, maybe you shouldn't forget that it is the party that made you president."
"A fact that I'm aware of."
"I am."
"But us democrats have already established our demands, which were apparently ignored by you."
"You cannot claim that you're the democrat here."
"But at this point, even my support would not be enough."
"Where to even begin?"
"Let's hear your problems."
entradas.menu: "Let's hear your problems."

entradas.text: "How about some other deal?"
entradas.menu: "How about some other deal?"

entradas.text: "I can't let you sabotage this."
entradas.menu: "I can't let you sabotage this."

entradas.text: "Don't forget who you are speaking to."
entradas.menu: "Don't forget who you are speaking to."

entradas.text: "What do you mean?"
entradas.menu: "What do you mean?"

entradas.text: "Tell me the issues. How can I get your support?"
entradas.menu: "Tell me the issues. How can I get your support?"

entradas.text: "This proposal will have hard time getting support in its current status. You surely know that."
"You are sabotaging yourself if you're not willing to listen the reformists in your own party..."
"First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the drastic decrease in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott it."

"That will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of parties could potentially enter the parliament. The electoral finance reform reduces their ability to campaign but nonetheless the situation won't be in our favour at all."
"We have specifically asked for a change in appointment of ministers. This is what the party was expecting."
He paused and twiddled his thumbs.
"Yet I see that our suggestions were completely ignored."
"Excuse me, Mr. President, but how are they not ignored?"
"That's not a priority for us."
entradas.menu: "That's not a priority for us."

entradas.text: "They were not ignored, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "They were not ignored, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "We can address that now."
entradas.menu: "We can address that now."

entradas.text: "I don't know what I can do for you even if I gave you my support. The party will not like this."
"Who's us? Isn't the party included in that now?"
"Oh?"
"Gloria and the conservatives didn't seem to have any problems with it."
entradas.menu: "Gloria and the conservatives didn't seem to have any problems with it."

entradas.text: "What is that supposed to mean? *We* have a problem with it."
"Let's see then..."
"Here. I already have my suggestion here."
He pulled out a stack of papers and placed them on his desk.
The papers contained suggested amendments to the Constitution.
I skimmed through the law he pointed out. "Council of Ministers are formed upon the President's appointment of them from a list of nominees that the Grand National Assembly selects."
"Leave the rest of the party to me. I am now asking for *your* support."
entradas.menu: "Leave the rest of the party to me. I am now asking for *your* support."

entradas.text: "We can add the requested change to the proposal."
entradas.menu: "We can add the requested change to the proposal."

entradas.text: "Screw the party."
entradas.menu: "Screw the party."

entradas.text: "Oh yeah?"
"Your proposal will be crushed like this anyway. I'd rather have something tangible to support."
"First of all, we are concerned about where this proposal is heading."
"It aims to give you absolute immunity with no way of impeachment."
"But never mind that now. There are far worse problems. We are not sure where this proposal is heading."
"I thought you were one of us. Against Sollism and the concentration of power. This is wrong."
"I am against Sollism. This law is necessary to protect me from the Court."
entradas.menu: "I am against Sollism. This law is necessary to protect me from the Court."

entradas.text: "I'm sure we can work something out."
entradas.menu: "I'm sure we can work something out."

entradas.text: "Well, you were wrong, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "Well, you were wrong, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."
entradas.menu: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."

entradas.text: "It will not only protect you but also your successors, Mr. President. This law has the potential to create another Soll."
"Well, yeah. You are right."
He raised an eyebrow and then frowned at me.
"So you want to hear our concerns or you are only here to push your agenda?"
"I'm sure we can work out *something else*."
entradas.menu: "I'm sure we can work out *something else*."

entradas.text: "This isn't how you *curb* the power of the Old Guards... This proposal instead gives more power to the executive. How is this any better than before?"
"I see that clearly now."
"Then I cannot help you."

"You are removing the Justices' immunity and giving it to yourself. This is borderline dictatorial since you can also replace them at your whim. Did you forget that we are democrats at heart, Mr. President?"
"Then I cannot help you."
"You are giving yourself absolute immunity and still keeping your extensive decree powers. Who do you think we are to support such changes, Mr. President?"
"That is not a good start. But let's look at the other issues first then."
"That is not a good start."
"As long as this law and the threshold remains, I don't think I can give you my support."
"As much as I want to give you my support, you are forcing our hand with this proposal..."
"It isn't about more powers, it is only protection."
entradas.menu: "It isn't about more powers, it is only protection."

entradas.text: "Okay, let's change this law."
entradas.menu: "Okay, let's change this law." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."
entradas.menu: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."

entradas.text: "I understand where you're coming from but us reformists cannot agree to this change. This is the very political culture that we are fighting against."
"Let's say we trust you and you become the greatest leader ever lived. And then, what happens when you leave office?"
"You mean it?"
"That's a positive development."
"Reformists were expecting a reform about the term limits. Why is that not included in the proposal?"
"Oh yeah? What do you have in mind?"
"Let's remove the change from the proposal."
entradas.menu: "Let's remove the change from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Maybe I can help you some other way..."
entradas.menu: "Maybe I can help you some other way..."

entradas.text: "It seems you have interesting dreams. But dreams, nonetheless."
"I would have understood your stance if this was the only issue... There are more."
"I think you're pushing your luck too much, Mr. President."
"You know... This isn't the only issue. There's another one."
"At least you decided to make some democratic changes to the term limits, Mr. President."
"That wasn't a priority."
entradas.menu: "That wasn't a priority."

entradas.text: "This is only my first term. It's too soon to bring term limits."
entradas.menu: "This is only my first term. It's too soon to bring term limits."

entradas.text: "We can address that today."
entradas.menu: "We can address that today."

entradas.text: "So, you also want to use the flaws of the system for your own benefit."
"That's good to know."
"What is a priority for you, Mr. President?"
"I thought there would be some reform about the extensive decree powers..."
He stared directly into my eyes.
"Fine. Let's discuss this."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Let's discuss this."

entradas.text: "There isn't going to be reforms about the decrees."
entradas.menu: "There isn't going to be reforms about the decrees."

entradas.text: "Look. We need the decrees to pass further reforms. I can't give away everything."
entradas.menu: "Look. We need the decrees to pass further reforms. I can't give away everything."

entradas.text: Change the proposal accordingly.
entradas.menu: Change the proposal accordingly. [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "On a second thought, I won't change this."
entradas.menu: "On a second thought, I won't change this."

entradas.text: "Limiting the legislative powers of the Supreme Court."
entradas.menu: "Limiting the legislative powers of the Supreme Court."

entradas.text: "Balance and division of powers."
entradas.menu: "Balance and division of powers."

entradas.text: "Bringing down the Constitution of Soll."
entradas.menu: "Bringing down the Constitution of Soll."

entradas.text: "You should have read our manifesto."
entradas.menu: "You should have read our manifesto."

entradas.text: "You are giving yourself absolute immunity..."
"...and keeping your extensive powers."
"And you're doing more than that, aren't you? Taking away the immunity of the Justices and giving the power to impeach to the parliament which our, or should I say, your party controls."
"Fair enough."
"By giving yourself the same rights as Soll?"
"Do you want me to believe that?"
"Could you tell me... What is your priority with this proposal?"
He let out a fake laughter.
"Let's see then... There is one more problem."
"And there is more..."
"Let's see then... What are you thinking about?"
"We'll bring term limits of 2."
entradas.menu: "We'll bring term limits of 2."

entradas.text: "On a second thought, I'd rather not include any changes to term limits."
entradas.menu: "On a second thought, I'd rather not include any changes to term limits."

entradas.text: "I told you. This is a power grab. I can't support this."
"You should at least do something about term limits."
"You should at least do something about the threshold. The party will not like this."
"We prefer some kind of reform. The president currently holds too much power."
"I suggest limiting the power of the decrees with an enabling act. The Assembly should have some control over a potential rogue president."
"And if you really care about further democratic reforms, we'll issue the enabling act. But we have to make sure the presidents can't work alone anymore."
"It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees."
entradas.menu: "It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."
entradas.menu: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."

entradas.text: "I can't let the Assembly control me."
entradas.menu: "I can't let the Assembly control me."

entradas.text: "I thought you wanted to discuss a change..."
"Lovely."
"I'm sure there's some *other way* to convince you."
entradas.menu: "I'm sure there's some *other way* to convince you."

entradas.text: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I don't think I want that."
entradas.menu: "I don't think I want that."

entradas.text: "Now, we're getting somewhere."
"I see."
"You should at least do something about the party's demand for minister reforms."
"Fine..."
"How about the other problem?"
"A pleasant surprise. Let's move on."
"Fine..."
He looked down at the proposal.
"Fine. I will add your suggestion."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will add your suggestion." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "The ministers should be nominated by the Assembly."
"That's a no."
entradas.menu: "That's a no."

entradas.text: "Fine. I will remove the decrease in the threshold."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the decrease in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Fine. I will bring a limit of 2 terms."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will bring a limit of 2 terms." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Okay. I'll reform the decrees then."
entradas.menu: "Okay. I'll reform the decrees then."

entradas.text: "Looking good!"
"Maybe I can offer you something else..."
entradas.menu: "Maybe I can offer you something else..."

entradas.text: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Okay. I'll reform the decrees then."
entradas.menu: "Okay. I'll reform the decrees then."

entradas.text: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Fine. I will remove the threshold change."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the threshold change." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "That's a no."
entradas.menu: "That's a no."

entradas.text: "Finally, we're getting somewhere."
"Now, we're getting somewhere."
"That's a shame."
"It's looking good."
"There might... still be a way for me to get behind this."
"... perhaps there is something else you could offer me."
"Let's look at the draft again. I will give concessions."
entradas.menu: "Let's look at the draft again. I will give concessions."

entradas.text: "Sure. I'll offer you *something else*."
entradas.menu: "Sure. I'll offer you *something else*."

entradas.text: "Pff. This meeting is over."
entradas.menu: "Pff. This meeting is over."

entradas.text: "Remove the change to the threshold and we will be as golden as Rizia. No need to agitate our party, Mr. President."
"I will support the proposal and get the needed signatures from our wing."
"However you see fit, Mr. President. I hope I didn't offend you in some way."
"This is not enough, Mr. President. We can take another look over the draft or... perhaps there is something else you could offer me."
"You already know our concerns."
We both buried our heads inside the proposal.
"I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers."
entradas.menu: "I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President."
entradas.menu: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will limit presidential decrees with the requirement for an enabling act."
entradas.menu: "I will limit presidential decrees with the requirement for an enabling act." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "It wasn't so hard, was it?"
"I guess it's acceptable now."
"But unfortunately, Mr. President. This is not enough. Either we change more or...."
"Let's just move on."
entradas.menu: "Let's just move on."

entradas.text: "I will also add term limits. 2 should be enough."
entradas.menu: "I will also add term limits. 2 should be enough." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will also remove the changes to the Justices' immunity."
entradas.menu: "I will also remove the changes to the Justices' immunity." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Great!"
"Fine. I will remove the changes to the threshold."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the changes to the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "It wasn't so hard, was it?"
"No. I can't do it."
entradas.menu: "No. I can't do it."

entradas.text: "Good to know, Mr. President."
"I believe the reformist votes that I have will be very important to you."
"Who knows? Maybe you'll consider me for a job in the government in the future for this."
"I'll consider you, if you prove yourself useful in the vote."
entradas.menu: "I'll consider you, if you prove yourself useful in the vote."

entradas.text: "I'll be expecting your votes, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "I'll be expecting your votes, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "See you in the conference, Mr. President."
"Oh, you know I will, Mr. President."
"Of course."
"I'll have their signatures soon."
"I won't."
"Don't botch it."
entradas.menu: "Don't botch it."

entradas.text: "I will talk to my guys shortly."
"You bet I will, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "You bet I will, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "I'm sorry to say that there's nothing I can do for you, Mr. President."
"Good luck with uniting the party under your reforms. But I guess you will be uniting the party against you like this."
"Which is an achievement too, I guess."
"We'll see, Mr. President."
"Anyway, I need to get back to work, Mr. President."
"I understand. I won't bother you any longer."
entradas.menu: "I understand. I won't bother you any longer."

entradas.text: "I'll be expecting the reformists' support, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "I'll be expecting the reformists' support, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "Goodbye, Mr. Clavin."
entradas.menu: "Goodbye, Mr. Clavin."

entradas.text: "That's not what I meant, sir."
"It's okay, Mr. Clavin. I took no offense."
entradas.menu: "It's okay, Mr. Clavin. I took no offense."

entradas.text: "Goodbye, Mr. President."
I left his room and went back into the corridor.
entradas.menu: Leave the room.

entradas.text: I left his room and went back into the corridor.
I left his room and went back into the corridor.
"I'm all ears."
"If you give us your support, you'll be my VP in my next cabinet."
entradas.menu: "If you give us your support, you'll be my VP in my next cabinet. [Collusion]"

entradas.text: "How about this?"
entradas.menu: "How about this? [Show him a cheque]"

entradas.text: I took out a cheque and showed it to him. It immediately got his attention.
"A lot."
entradas.menu: "A lot. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "That was very direct..."
"...How much are we talking about here?"
"Life-changing amount."
entradas.menu: "Life-changing amount." [-2 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "Name your price."
entradas.menu: "Name your price."

entradas.text: "I didn't know you were such a *businessman*."
"Look, Mr. President. I'm on the same side as you."
"An interesting proposal."
"One that's very hard to turn down."
"Especially now that I think we align, Mr. President."
"Can I hold you to that promise?"
"But not quite enough."
"I can't really support the proposal without at least some change to these points of concerns."
He showed the listed problems which were outlined on a piece of paper.
"I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers."
entradas.menu: "I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President."
entradas.menu: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will limit presidential decrees with the requirement for an enabling act."
entradas.menu: "I will limit presidential decrees with the requirement for an enabling act." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "Fine. Whatever it takes to get this proposal through the Assembly."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Whatever it takes to get this proposal through the Assembly."

entradas.text: "Great. I knew that we could agree on something."
"How about a position in my cabinet?"
entradas.menu: "How about a position in my cabinet?"

entradas.text: "I think we can achieve a lot, if we lead together."
"Well... If you promise me the position of the Vice President."
"I'm afraid I can't do that."
entradas.menu: "I'm afraid I can't do that."

entradas.text: "That's a shame."
"How about two of those cheques you're holding?"
"Here you go."
entradas.menu: "Here you go. [Give him two cheques for -2 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "How about only one for now?"
entradas.menu: "How about only one for now?"

entradas.text: "That's too much."
entradas.menu: "That's too much."

entradas.text: "I thought you were a wealthy man..."
"Here's one. This will be enough."
entradas.menu: "Here's one. This will be enough. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

entradas.text: "I think there won't be any deal today."
entradas.menu: "I think there won't be any deal today."

entradas.text: "That's a shame."
"Glad to be making business with you."
He took the cheque and slid it into the pocket of his jacket.
He glanced at the proposal on the table.
"Now your offer has indeed become something very persuasive."
"Of course. I am a man of my word."
entradas.menu: "Of course. I am a man of my word."

entradas.text: "I don't intend to run with Petr again. It'll be you, I promise."
entradas.menu: "I don't intend to run with Petr again. It'll be you, I promise."

entradas.text: "As long as I get your support."
entradas.menu: "As long as I get your support."

entradas.text: "Good. Then it seems like we have a deal."
"I won't create any problems."
"That's what I wanted to hear."
entradas.menu: "That's what I wanted to hear."

entradas.text: "That's good to know."
entradas.menu: "That's good to know."

entradas.text: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin. Any help from you is much appreciated."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Mr. Clavin. Any help from you is much appreciated."

entradas.text: "I wanted to express my gratitude for passing the Workers' Rights Act. It is one of my most comprehensive and successful political efforts."
"Our team was disappointed by the veto of the Workers' Rights Act. We worked day and night for weeks. It would have boosted your public opinion too, Mr. President."
"It wasn't a good time for a drastic changes which would also costs the government."
entradas.menu: "It wasn't a good time for a drastic changes which would also costs the government."

entradas.text: "You and I see eye to eye on many subjects including this one."
entradas.menu: "You and I see eye to eye on many subjects including this one."

entradas.text: "The businesses would be burdened even further. In this climate it would damage the economy."
entradas.menu: "The businesses would be burdened even further. In this climate it would damage the economy."

entradas.text: "Your efforts were appreciated by the Palace."
entradas.menu: "Either way, your efforts were appreciated by the Palace."

entradas.text: "It was the right thing to do because our workers were suffering for decades."
entradas.menu: "It was the right thing to do because our workers were suffering for decades."

entradas.text: "The party effort had to be supported."
entradas.menu: "The party effort had to be supported."

entradas.text: "Indeed the people will credit your administration and the party for a positive change in their lives."
"I have to say, the close collaboration between the palace and the party is going well. Looking forward to what we can accomplish with the reforms."
"Music to my ears."
"It never is. Not sure how this will reflect on the public opinion, I wouldn't imagine positively."
"I understand your perspective but haven't the companies benefitted from this situation and made profit for a long time?"
"Actions would have gone farther than words."
"It seems that the administration is taking a very pro-business approach."
Albin smiled and knocked on wood.
He poured himself some water and had a sip before continuing.
"It's just that we thought the Palace wouldn't let us down."
"The businesses will share the burden with the state but it is a change they have to abide by."
"The worker's revolution will begin with small steps."
entradas.menu: "The worker's revolution will begin with small steps."

entradas.text: "One would think that I'm talking to Ms. Walda. The party doesn't support such ideologies as you know."
"Personally there are some principles that I respect in Malenyevism but I wouldn't accept it in it's entirety."
"It is a market economy with a free supply and demand system. The government shouldn't overregulate."
entradas.menu: "It is a market economy with a free supply and demand system. The government shouldn't overregulate."

entradas.text: "The situation is borderline exploitative, that is why the majority of the assembly gathered behind it. The act was supposed to bring some regulation which didn't exist before."
"It wouldn't be possible without Paskal Beniwoll's support. The Labour Union and several NGO's like Magnus Cartus also contributed to the campaigning."
Albin sighed.

"First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the increase in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott that since the expectation from us is to democratise, not do the opposite."
"Our constituents wouldn't accept the situation."
"The change will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of new parties could potentially enter the parliament."
"Combined with the electoral finance reform no other party can ever make it to the parliament. Our constituents wouldn't accept the situation."
"Fine. I will remove the increase in the threshold."
entradas.menu: "Fine. I will remove the increase in the threshold."

entradas.text: "You are removing the Justices' immunity and giving the ability to impeach it to the parliament. I'm a parliamentarian at heart and while I think this strengthens the people's representative power, it still is wrong."
"Who do you think we are to support such changes, Mr. President?"
"I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices."
entradas.menu: " I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "And you're doing more than that, aren't you? Taking away the immunity of the Justices and giving the power to replace them to yourself. A worrying notion."
"I will remove the decrease in the threshold."
entradas.menu: "I will remove the decrease in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will remove the increase in the threshold."
entradas.menu: "I will remove the increase in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "This particular change is specifically worrying as it represents an opposite trend. The decrees need to be weaker not stronger."
"To truly reform the country the President needs decrees not subject to review."
entradas.menu: "To truly reform the country the President needs decrees not subject to review."

entradas.text: "What is wrong with a USP President having strong decree powers?"
entradas.menu: "What is wrong with a USP President having strong decree powers?"

entradas.text: "I respect the perspective of the reformist wing."
entradas.menu: "I respect the perspective of the reformist wing."

entradas.text: "What I didn't expect was a worsening of the current situation. Presidential decrees above statute law and not subject to judicial review... It would destroy the separation of powers."
"And the attempt to offset this by adding an override of the veto power to the parliament only to have no time limit to act is a very low move. Tricks like this won't go unnoticed."
"I thought you wanted to discuss a change..."
"There must be another way."
entradas.menu: "There must be another way."

entradas.text: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I see."
"I don't think I want that."
entradas.menu: "I don't think I want that."

entradas.text: "I can't let the Assembly control me."
entradas.menu: "I can't let the Assembly control me."

entradas.text: "Lovely."
"I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."
entradas.menu: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."

entradas.text: "Lovely."
"It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees."
entradas.menu: "It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "The fact that we are giving the Assembly the power to override a veto is change enough."
entradas.menu: "The fact that we are giving the Assembly the power to override a veto is change enough."

entradas.text: "You didn't include any time limit for that response thus creating a loophole which puts us back to square one. Nothing."
"And if you really care about further democratic reforms, we'll issue the enabling act. But we have to make sure the presidents can't work alone anymore."
"I suggest limiting the power of the decrees with an enabling act. The Assembly should have some control over a potential rogue president."
"Well there were some subjects that were wrong about Tarquin Soll and we don't want to see a repeat of that."
"Enough to make a slight change that would heavily influence our tendencies to support the draft?"
"Why can't the President work closely with the Assembly?"
"Which under this draft proposal also would have immunity for life once retired."
"And your abolishment of the honorary membership indicates that you are a democrat too."
"But the extent of your democratic beliefs matter."
"The removal of the honorary membership won't be respected by the party either."
"Very well. I accept."
entradas.menu: "Very well. I accept. [Collusion]"

entradas.text: "I wouldn't mind if my next Vice President had a bit more... funds."
entradas.menu: "I wouldn't mind if my next Vice President had a bit more... funds. [Show him a cheque]"

entradas.text: I took out a cheque and showed it to him. It immediately got his attention.
"You certainly know how to make compelling arguments, don't you Mr. President?"
He took the cheque and slid it into the pocket of his jacket.
"Glad to be making business with you."
"I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers."
entradas.menu: "I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President."
entradas.menu: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

entradas.text: He took a deep breath then let out a long sigh.
"On a second thought, I'm fine with the current draft."
entradas.menu: "On a second thought, I'm fine with the current draft."
